momentum.def: The product of an object's mass and velocity, p = mv: a vector along the velocity, in kg·m/s.

collision-model.def: The model of a brief, strong interaction (a collision or an explosion) in which internal forces far exceed external ones, so the system's momentum is the same just before and just after.

cm-velocity.def: The velocity of a system's center of mass: the system's momentum divided by its total mass, v_cm = Σp/Σm.
